purpose: Pool page counts recorded from engines that were then measured under deep
concurrent load. scripts/check-residency-geometry.py compares a live boot against
these numbers: the attention block size is a mechanism assertion (a change voids
every page-arithmetic conclusion), the page count is a drift warning (a change moves
the eviction band, which is measured, not derived).
